data.title: [Party Together] - [Gift Box Castell] Fest Event Details

data.data:
▼// Event Time

Asia Server: May 14, 2026 at 12:00 (server time) – Before version update and maintenance on June 5, 2026 at 06:00

Americas / Europe Server: May 14, 2026 at 12:00 (server time) – Before version update and maintenance on June 4, 2026 at 17:00


· Asia Server Time Zone: UTC+8

· Americas / Europe Server Time Zone: UTC-5


▼// Event Rewards

During the event, reach specified event points to unlock and claim the Dijiang display item [Companions Figurine].


▼// Participation Requirements

After the Event Center is unlocked


▼// Event Details

· [Party Together] is divided into 2 phases. This event features Phase 2: [Gift Box Castell].

· During [Gift Box Castell], you can earn event points by stacking gift boxes.

· Once the required event points are reached, the reward will be sent to you via in-game mail. The mail will expire in 30 days, so please claim the reward in time.


※ Phase 1 event [Pastry Tower] is still ongoing. Please take part and claim your rewards before it ends.

※ For more event details, please check the [Party Together] page.
